## Cover

The cover consists of one or more pages that are placed at the start of the photo book.

This will usually have the following pages.

-   **Cover** photo with the book's title and author's name as a single page.

-   **Copyright** information as a single page.

-   **Introduction** as a single or multiple pages.

All of this is bundled into a single pdf file.

The name of the cover file can be anything as you identify this file in the code when the photoPress function is assembling the book.
